gaps.explanation: Statement lines: accrual Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Change in Net Position - Proprietary Funds (p6, printed p8): User fees 401,828 + Other 1,771 = Total operating revenues 403,599. Difference 407,406 - 403,599 = 3,807 is exactly '(In)decrease accounts receivable 3,807' on the proprietary Statement of Cash Flows (p7): cash collected exceeds accrual revenue. Bond proceeds 660,000 is non-operating on p6 and other financing on p10 (detail 35) - on neither side of this comparison. No line missing or doubled.

Printed totals differ by basis; no line to add or remove.
